name: DashCore
description: Android64 Bismuth-inspired rendering diagnostics for Geometry Dash. Adds per-class GameObject and trigger-flag census diagnostics, with up to 16 trigger samples. Retains 600-frame Android64 performance sampling; GPU visibility remains diagnostic only and live render culling is hard-disabled.

experimental-render-culling.name: Experimental render culling (locked off)
experimental-render-culling.description: Reserved for future testing. DashCore 0.8.3 hard-disables live object hiding; all grouped objects, triggers, and effects remain protected.
